category_overview: These six platforms embed AI inside the system of record each vendor already owns: ServiceNow for IT, employee and customer service plus GRC, Salesforce for CRM, SAP for ERP/procurement/supply chain, Workday for HCM and finance, Atlassian for work management, and UiPath for automation that crosses systems. They overlap increasingly at the edges: ServiceNow, Workday, Salesforce and SAP all now sell employee self-service agents and cross-vendor agent governance (AI Control Tower, Agent System of Record, Agentforce 360, SAP AI Agent Hub), and ServiceNow, Workday, UiPath and Atlassian expose MCP-based action layers so third-party assistants such as Claude or Copilot can act inside them. Enterprises typically standardise on the AI of whichever platform holds the data (ServiceNow for ITSM, Salesforce for CRM, SAP for ERP, Workday for HR, Jira for engineering/PMO) and use UiPath where work spans systems, rather than buying a separate assistant per platform. The common 2025-2026 shift is from per-seat add-ons to consumption metering (assists, Flex Credits, AI Units, Rovo credits, Platform Units), so budget governance, output review and admin controls are the shared training themes; all six vendors now hold ISO/IEC 42001 certification.

tools.name: ServiceNow Now Assist
tools.vendor: ServiceNow, Inc. (brief correct); Now Assist is the generative-AI skill and agent layer of the ServiceNow AI Platform.
tools.what_it_is: Generative-AI 'skills' and AI agents embedded in ServiceNow workflow products (ITSM, CSM, HRSD, FSM, ITOM, SPM, IRM, SecOps, Creator). Users meet it inside the ServiceNow UI and Virtual Agent (portal, Microsoft Teams, Slack, mobile); agents are built in AI Agent Studio and governed through AI Control Tower.
key_capabilities: Incident, case and change summaries; resolution notes; knowledge-article generation (ITSM, CSM, HRSD)
LLM-driven Virtual Agent that answers from knowledge or files requests in portal, Teams, Slack and mobile
Prebuilt and custom AI agents (AI Agent Studio/Orchestrator); May 2026 'Autonomous Workforce' specialists for IT, CRM, HR, finance, legal, procurement, security and risk
Model choice via Generative AI Controller: Now LLM, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or bring-your-own
AI Control Tower (discover, observe, govern, secure, measure) plus Action Fabric MCP server exposing governed actions to third-party agents
Creator skills: text-to-code/flow, Build Agent, UI Builder Agent, ATF troubleshooting
tools.enterprise_data_handling: All tiers (platform-level): Data Privacy for Now Assist (Yokohama+) masks sensitive data in prompts and responses before they leave the instance, for every configured LLM; it does not mask data inside the instance. Contributing data to improve ServiceNow models is optional and anonymised (customer choice per ServiceNow FAQ). ISO/IEC 42001 certified 18 Dec 2025 (scope: AIMS for ServiceNow AI including agents); FedRAMP High Impact per partner blog; Moveworks (acquired Dec 2025) FedRAMP Moderate (Feb 2026). ServiceNow's official trust/compliance pages blocked automated access, so SOC 2 and ISO 27001 scope were not re-verified. Nine native languages; GCC customers have Now Assist with some feature gaps.
tools.licensing_pricing: No published list prices; contact sales. Until April 2026 Now Assist required Pro Plus/Enterprise Plus SKUs per workflow (typically a 30-60% uplift on every licensed user) plus 'assists' consumption. From 9 April 2026 three cumulative tiers, Foundation/Advanced/Prime, bundle Now Assist with annual assist pools (e.g., ITSM fulfiller 1,500 assists on Foundation, 3,000 on Advanced; small action 25 assists, agentic action 150); only Prime allows custom skills/agents; legacy Plus SKUs end of sale 1 July 2026. Each workflow product needs its own entitlement. Not bundled with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
tools.integrations: Microsoft Teams and Slack (Virtual Agent); IRM/GRC, Vendor Risk and SecOps modules; CMDB/Workflow Data Fabric; AI Control Tower connectors to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, SAP, Oracle and Workday; MCP Action Fabric for Claude, Copilot or custom agents; Veza, Armis, Traceloop and Moveworks (acquisitions).
tools.recent_developments: Sept 2025 Zurich release: agentic playbooks, Build Agent, Vault and Machine Identity consoles. Dec 2025: Moveworks acquisition and ISO 42001. 9 Apr 2026: Foundation/Advanced/Prime packaging with assists metering. May 2026 Knowledge: AI Control Tower expansion (GA Aug 2026), Autonomous Workforce, Action Fabric MCP server, Autonomous Security & Risk (GA Sept 2026). Rename flag: 'Now Assist' remains the skill brand, but agents are now marketed as 'AI specialists'/'Autonomous Workforce' on the 'ServiceNow AI Platform'.
tools.best_fit_departments: Best: 37 Customer Support, 45 IT Infrastructure, 55 Service Delivery and 18 Workplace Admin, where ticket/request skills are mature. Good only if IRM/VRM/SecOps modules are licensed: 05 ERM, 07 Regulatory Compliance, 48 Security GRC, 26 Vendor Management. Weak: 09 Ethics & Investigations (generic case summarisation only) and 59 BC/DR (major-incident communications only, no DR-specific skills).
tools.training_notes: Learners must know which record data a skill reads, review summaries and resolution notes before posting, understand assist consumption, masking limits, and human approval of agent actions. Core (18, 37): 6-10 h; Advanced (05, 09, 26, 45, 55): 12-20 h including skill configuration and playbooks; Specialist (07, 48, 59): 20-40 h including IRM/SecOps setup, AI Agent Studio and AI Control Tower governance.
tools.caveats: Opaque pricing; uplift is charged on non-adopters; agentic use drains assist pools about 12x faster and overages are negotiable only at renewal; AI in one workflow does not extend to others; Plus SKUs cannot be reinstated after 1 July 2026; hallucination risk means human approval for sensitive actions; GCC feature gaps; servicenow.com product and trust pages could not be opened for automated verification.

tools.name: Salesforce Einstein
tools.vendor: Salesforce, Inc. (brief correct). 'Einstein' now denotes the predictive/generative features and the Einstein Trust Layer inside the Agentforce 360 Platform; Einstein Copilot was renamed Agentforce.
tools.what_it_is: Native AI inside Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service and the Salesforce platform: predictive scoring and forecasting, generative Einstein GPT features (call summaries, sales emails, service replies, knowledge creation) and the Trust Layer. Conversational assistants and autonomous agents are sold as Agentforce and used in the Salesforce UI, Slack and via Claude ('Claudeforce').
key_capabilities: Einstein Lead/Opportunity Scoring, Forecasting, Activity Capture, Case Classification, reply and article recommendations
Einstein GPT for Sales and Service: call explorer and summaries, sales emails, work summaries, service replies, knowledge creation; Field Service pre-work briefs
Agentforce SDR, Sales Coach, Service Agent, Employee Agent and Coworker on the Atlas Reasoning Engine, with Agent Script, Agentforce Builder and Voice
Prompt Builder and Einstein Studio; grounding on Data 360 (Intelligent Context, Tableau Semantics)
Model choice across OpenAI, Anthropic and Google Gemini
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Einstein Trust Layer (all generative features, all editions): zero data retention, so prompts and outputs are not stored by or used to train third-party LLMs; PII masking before prompts; toxicity filtering; permission enforcement and audit logging. Einstein Platform Security, Privacy and Architecture document (Jul 2026): ISO 27001/27017/27018, ISO 42001 (Agentforce and Einstein AI Platform), SOC 2, IRAP, ISMAP, EU/UK BCR, Data Privacy Framework; card numbers and government IDs may not be submitted and PHI only to 'PHI-Permitted Services'; customer data deleted within 120 days of termination; anonymised aggregate usage data may be used. Hyperforce regions in US, Canada, Asia-Pacific and EMEA.
tools.licensing_pricing: Official USD list (annual terms): Flex Credits $500 per 100,000 (standard action 20 credits = $0.10, voice $0.15); Agentforce User License $5/user/month plus credits; Agentforce Coworker $50/user/month; Agentforce for Sales/Service/Field Service add-on $125/user/month unmetered; Industry Clouds $150; Max edition from $550/user/month including 2.75M credits per org per year; $2 per customer-facing conversation; Foundations tools free. Per Supered: Sept 2026 Sales Cloud editions Core $195, Advanced $395, Max $550 with 0.5M/1M/2.75M credits. Predictive Einstein features are bundled in certain Sales/Service Cloud editions. Not bundled with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
tools.integrations: Sales, Service and Field Service Cloud; Data 360; Slack (agentic interface with MCP); Tableau; Amazon Connect and Five9 for Agentforce Voice; Databricks, dbt and Snowflake semantic partnerships; Claude via Claudeforce; email and calendar via Einstein Activity Capture.
tools.recent_developments: Renames: Einstein Copilot to Agentforce; Einstein 1 Editions to Agentforce 1; Data Cloud to Data 360; Topics to 'subagents' (Apr 2026); 'Agentforce Sales' reverted to Sales Cloud after 11 days (Sept 2026). 13 Oct 2025: Agentforce 360 GA with Builder, Voice and Agent Script; Gemini added to OpenAI/Anthropic. Oct 2025: ISO 42001. 14 Feb 2026: Legacy Chat retired; Einstein Bots rebuilt as Agentforce. 2026: 'AIforce' umbrella (Claudeforce, Slackforce); MCP calls to be metered.
tools.best_fit_departments: Best: 28 Enterprise Sales and 29 SMB/Inside Sales (scoring, SDR agent, email and call summaries), 30 Sales/RevOps (forecasting, pipeline), 36 Customer Success (service agent, case summaries, Data 360 health signals). Moderate: 35 Pre-Sales, which needs custom prompts since there is no RFP product. 46 Enterprise Apps & ERP fits only as the CRM admin/agent-builder role, not ERP.
tools.training_notes: Master CRM data hygiene (scores depend on it), grounding prompts with Data 360, reviewing generated emails for accuracy and PII, Trust Layer audit trails, credit budgeting, and agent guardrails and escalation. Core (28, 29): 6-10 h; Advanced (30, 35, 36): 12-20 h including Prompt Builder and reports; Specialist (46): 20-40 h including Agentforce Builder, Agent Script, Data 360 setup and credit governance.
tools.caveats: Three renames in a year confuse SKUs and documentation; credits expire at term end; the $125 unmetered add-on versus credit models needs modelling; predictive features need enough history; no automated migration from Legacy Chat or Einstein Bots; contractual sensitive-data limits; official Einstein product URLs now redirect to AIforce, so learners should rely on Help documentation.

tools.name: SAP Joule
tools.vendor: SAP SE (brief correct); Joule is the assistant and agent layer of SAP Business AI.
tools.what_it_is: SAP's generative-AI copilot, embedded as a side panel in SAP cloud applications (S/4HANA Cloud public and private editions, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Fieldglass, Signavio, IBP, Datasphere, Analytics Cloud, BTP), in Microsoft Teams, and since October 2026 as Joule Work/Joule Desktop, a cross-app conversational home that orchestrates Joule agents; Joule Studio builds custom agents.
key_capabilities: Navigational, informational (conversational search over SAP Help and grounded documents), transactional and analytical (SAP Analytics Cloud) capability types
Joule Skills across finance, sourcing and procurement, supply chain, HR (SuccessFactors recruiting, onboarding, compensation, payroll, learning) and Concur expense/travel
200+ specialised agents orchestrated by 50+ domain Joule Assistants (e.g., Autonomous Close); Ariba Intake/Contracts and Fieldglass agents GA June 2026
Joule Studio 2.0: no-code to pro-code (LangChain, Pydantic AI, LlamaIndex, VS Code/Cursor) with MCP and A2A support
Joule Work, Desktop and Spaces with voice and mobile; SAP AI Agent Hub (Q3 2026, no extra charge); Joule for Consultants and Developers
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Same posture for Base and Premium. SAP cites ISO 42001 (independent registry: scope includes Joule, AI Core, AI Launchpad), ISO 27001/27018, SOC 1/2 reports, EU AI Act and GDPR alignment and an AI ethics policy. SAP's Teams-app attestation (May 2025): SOC 1/2 Type 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018, CSA STAR, SOX, Entra ID SSO, no customer data stored by the app, no FedRAMP. Activation requires accepting AI terms (SKU 8019544 or AI Unit SKU 8019164) in SAP for Me and assigning users via Central Business Configuration (new flow since 1 Apr 2026). Explicit 'no training on customer data' commitments were not visible on pages that could be opened.
tools.licensing_pricing: No per-user list price. Business AI Base (interactive Joule, embedded AI, Joule Skills) is included at no extra cost in qualifying SAP cloud subscriptions since July 2025. Premium AI is bought with AI Units: currently per-user-per-month packages for Finance, HCM and Supply Chain; from Q3 2026 every agent action costs 0.02 AI Units; Joule for Consultants stays at 35 AI Units per user per month; custom Joule Studio agents are free at runtime through end-2026, then billed via BTPEA/CPEA/PAYG. Redress: minimum 100 AI Units per year, expiring after 12 months, with the unit price set only in the order form. AI consumption is part of every SAP cloud renewal since July 2026. Not bundled with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace (a Teams app exists).
tools.integrations: S/4HANA Cloud, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Fieldglass, Signavio, IBP, Datasphere, Analytics Cloud, BTP (Build Work Zone, Kyma); Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot; model partners Anthropic, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Mistral AI, Cohere; MCP and A2A; Cursor and Claude Code for Studio.
tools.recent_developments: May 2025 new AI Unit SKU; July 2025 Business AI Base bundled. Q1 2026 Joule Studio agent builder GA; Apr 2026 new activation flow. 12 May 2026 Sapphire: 'Autonomous Enterprise' and Autonomous Suite (Finance, Spend, Supply Chain, HCM, CX), 50+ assistants, 200+ agents, Joule Studio 2.0, Joule Work, EUR 100M partner fund. Oct 2026: Autonomous Enterprise, Joule Work and Joule Desktop GA; shift to per-action AI Unit metering. Business ByDesign sunset Apr 2026. No rename, but 'Autonomous Suite' is the new umbrella over Joule.
tools.best_fit_departments: All five fit: 46 Enterprise Apps & ERP (S/4HANA, BTP, Joule Studio), 25 Procurement (Ariba and Fieldglass agents GA), 60 Supply Chain (S/4HANA supply chain, IBP), 21 Accounting (Autonomous Close, finance skills), 24 AP/AR (finance transactional skills; Document AI is metered). Weakest is 24 where invoicing runs outside SAP cloud editions.
tools.training_notes: Learners must know their edition and which skills are activated, phrase transactional versus informational requests, verify agent output against SAP authorisations, and monitor AI Unit use (scheduled agents multiply consumption). Advanced (21, 24, 25, 60): 12-20 h including SAC analytical questions and procurement agents; Specialist (46): 20-40 h covering SAP for Me activation, Joule Studio, unit monitoring and Teams integration.
tools.caveats: No Joule on classic on-premise S/4HANA, ECC, Business One or self-hosted private edition; the 2026 shift from per-user packages to per-action metering creates mid-contract uncertainty; units expire annually and overage runs 150-200% (Redress); much of the agent portfolio is roadmap (n8n canvas Q3, A2A and Governance Assistant Q4 2026); sap.com product and trust pages blocked automated verification; Teams attestation is self-reported and dated May 2025.

tools.name: Workday AI
tools.vendor: Workday, Inc. (brief correct). Marketed since March 2026 as 'Sana from Workday' plus Workday AI agents; the earlier 'Workday Illuminate' brand is retired.
tools.what_it_is: Role-specific AI agents for HR, finance and IT embedded in Workday HCM and Financials, surfaced through Sana, a conversational Workday Home that interprets requests and orchestrates agents, and governed by the Agent System of Record. Available in the Workday app, Slack, Microsoft Teams and Claude.
key_capabilities: HR agents: Recruiting (resume grading, talent rediscovery), Payroll (missing-data checks, minimum-wage Q&A), Workforce Management, Organizational Development, Talent Mobility, Contingent Sourcing, Frontline
Finance agents: Financial Audit evidence compilation, Contract negotiation and redlining, Procurement, Revenue Contract, Travel
Universal: Self-Service Agent, Sana Concierge (HR/IT request resolution), Sana Coach, Sana Learn, Core Reporting Agent, Decision Intelligence
Agent System of Record: agent inventory, permissions, audit and ROI tracking; Microsoft Entra Agent ID; Workday Data Cloud zero-copy sharing with Databricks, Snowflake and Salesforce
Workday Build: Developer Agent, Flowise agent builder, MCP-compliant APIs
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Platform-wide, all customers: Workday states it never shares customer data to train third-party public models, publishes AI Fact Sheets per feature, and lets customers configure how outputs are used. Certifications: SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701, ISO 42001 (June 2025, Schellman) and NIST AI RMF attestation (Coalfire), FedRAMP Moderate, HIPAA, IRAP, TISAX, TX-RAMP, Data Privacy Framework, EU Cloud Code of Conduct. The Agent System of Record gives admins access controls, permissions and activity logs. Whether de-identified customer data trains Workday's own models was not stated on the pages opened.
tools.licensing_pricing: No per-user list price; contact sales. Agents are sold through AI Flex Credits: an annual subscription pool, a complimentary allotment sized by company, Marketplace top-ups, metering on completed production actions (not tokens) with alerts at 80/90/100%. Rate card (12 Oct 2026): self-service action 1 credit, resume match score 6, talent rediscovery 750 per requisition, contract negotiation 500 per document, audit compilation 60 per sample, Sana AI storage 120 per GB per year, standard API 60 per 10k calls. The USD price per credit is not published; credits refresh annually with no rollover. Not bundled with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
tools.integrations: Microsoft Teams, Slack, Claude, Microsoft Entra Agent ID, Azure AI Foundry agents, Databricks/Snowflake/Salesforce zero-copy, Workday Extend, ConductorOne (identity acquisition).
tools.recent_developments: May 2025: next-generation Illuminate agents; June 2025: ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF. Sept 2025 Rising: Flex Credits, Workday Data Cloud, Agent System of Record with Entra, Workday Build; Sana acquisition (USD 1.1B, 2025). Rename flag: March 2026 'Illuminate' retired and agents regrouped under 'Sana from Workday' (Agentic HR, Agentic Finance). 13 Oct 2026 Rising: Sana becomes Workday Home; Sana Concierge early access (GA Q1 2027) and Sana Coach early access; Work Intelligence and Decision Intelligence; ConductorOne acquisition; Gartner AI-agents 'Market Shaper' (Sept 2026).
tools.best_fit_departments: All five fit: 12 Talent Acquisition (Recruiting agent), 14 Compensation/Benefits/Payroll (Payroll agent, total rewards), 15 Talent Management & Succession (Talent Mobility, Org Development, Sana Coach), 16 People Analytics (Core Reporting Agent, Decision Intelligence, Data Cloud), 11 HRBP (Self-Service, Sana Concierge). 11 is weakest until Concierge reaches GA.
tools.training_notes: Learners must know what each agent does and costs in credits, review scores, payroll exceptions and redlines before acting, read AI Fact Sheets for consequential HR decisions (EU AI Act, Colorado AI Act), and manage Agent System of Record permissions. Core (11): 6-10 h; Advanced (12, 15, 16): 12-20 h including agent configuration and reporting; Specialist (14): 20-40 h including payroll agent setup, compliance review and Flex Credit governance via the Consumption Console.
tools.caveats: Credit prices are unpublished so ROI needs rate-card modelling; high-cost skills (750 credits per requisition) drain pools; credits expire annually; many Sana features are still early access; two brand changes in a year confuse documentation; FedRAMP Moderate only; bias and explainability duties for consequential decisions remain with the employer.

tools.name: Jira Atlassian Intelligence
tools.vendor: Atlassian Corporation (brief correct). In-product AI is now marketed as Rovo (Search, Chat, Agents, Studio, Dev); 'Atlassian Intelligence' persists as the legacy name and in admin menus ('AI and Rovo').
tools.what_it_is: The AI layer built into Jira Cloud (and Confluence, Jira Service Management, Loom) on Atlassian's Teamwork Graph. It appears inline in work items, search, the automation builder and a Rovo Chat panel, with Rovo Agents acting on work and Rovo Studio for custom agents. Cloud only.
key_capabilities: Natural-language search and JQL generation and error fixing
Summaries of comments, work items and smart links; AI writing, editing, translation and tone changes
Task suggestions and work breakdown, field value recommendations, duplicate detection
Natural-language creation of automation rules
Rovo Chat (quick answer and Think Deeper), Rovo Agents with model selection, Rovo Studio, Rovo Dev; Virtual Service Agent in JSM
Models: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude (via AWS Bedrock), Google Gemini and open Llama/Phi models
tools.enterprise_data_handling: All paid cloud plans: inputs and outputs are not used to improve any LLM; OpenAI, Google and Anthropic store nothing (zero data retention); Atlassian retains data 30 days for safety; features honour instance permissions; organisation admins manage access under 'AI and Rovo' in Atlassian Administration, and AI is auto-enabled on Standard, Premium and Enterprise. SOC 2 reports cover Jira, Rovo and Rovo Dev. AI-specific data residency and ISO 27001 product scope were not visible on the pages opened; LLM routing is Atlassian's choice, not the customer's.
tools.licensing_pricing: Jira Cloud: Free (up to 10 users, no AI); Standard and Premium priced per user per month on a progressive scale; Enterprise annual, contact sales. Independent sources: from 13 Oct 2026 Standard USD 9.70 and Premium USD 19.60 per user per month at the 100-user band (previously 9.05/18.30); Atlassian's Premium page says Premium is about 2x Standard. Rovo credits included: 25/70/150 per user per month on Standard/Premium/Enterprise (250/700/1,500 in Teamwork and Service Collections), pooled org-wide with monthly reset; search, definitions and summaries are free, basic actions 10 credits; overage USD 0.01 per credit billed from 3 Dec 2026, on by default with admin spend caps and prepaid packs; Automation overage USD 0.50 per 1,000 steps. Not bundled with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
tools.integrations: Confluence, Jira Service Management, Loom, Bitbucket, Google Docs smart links, GitHub, Google and Microsoft connectors into the Teamwork Graph, MCP server for external assistants.
tools.recent_developments: Rovo included in all paid Jira and Confluence plans rather than sold as an add-on. Usage-based pricing: Rovo credits, Automation steps and AI resolutions become billable from 3 Dec 2026. 13 Oct 2026: Jira Standard and Premium prices up 7-10%, Enterprise up 8%. Model garden expanded to Gemini, Claude and open models; Rovo Dev coding agent. Rename flag: 'Atlassian Intelligence' is being superseded by 'Rovo'.
tools.best_fit_departments: 39 Product Management (work breakdown, summaries, automation generation, PRD drafting in Confluence) and 54 PMO (status and dependency summaries, Rovo agents for reports) both fit; 54 is weaker where cross-project dependency analysis needs Plans or Jira Align, which require Premium or above.
tools.training_notes: Learners must know which actions consume credits, verify generated JQL and summaries, keep sensitive data out of prompts where instance permissions are broad, build automation rules safely and understand admin spend caps. Core (39, 54): 6-10 h; add 4-6 h for Rovo Studio agent building.
tools.caveats: Cloud only; overage billing is on by default from Dec 2026 so admins must set caps; credit cost varies by feature; exact official per-user prices could not be fetched (independent sources used); no customer choice of LLM provider; AI unavailable on Free.

tools.name: UiPath Autopilot
tools.vendor: UiPath, Inc. (brief correct); Autopilot is the embedded AI assistant across the UiPath Platform for agentic automation.
tools.what_it_is: Generative-AI assistant built into UiPath: Autopilot for Developers (Studio and Studio Web text-to-workflow and a coding agent), for Testers (Test Manager), for Everyone (a chat assistant), and inside Maestro, Orchestrator and IXP. It is not a standalone app; it runs in Automation Cloud or on-premises Automation Suite 26.3+.
key_capabilities: Text-to-workflow and the Autopilot Coding Agent (GA Aug 2026 in Studio Desktop; preview in Studio Web and VS Code) with 30+ tools, MCP and AGENTS.md support
Maestro: scaffolds BPMN, Flow and Case processes from plain language; coding-agent skill for Maestro Flow (GA Sept 2026)
Testers: requirement analysis, test-step generation, text-to-automated tests
Everyone: conversational assistant that runs automations and answers from documents
Operations: flags job issues in Orchestrator before escalation
Model choice (GPT, Gemini, Claude) via the LLM Gateway, with every action logged by the AI Trust Layer
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Automation Cloud Standard and Enterprise: UiPath states it does not use customer data to train LLMs and that third-party models are not trained on Autopilot for Everyone data; chat and configuration data sit in Orchestrator storage buckets in the tenant's data-residency region; users can delete their data; the AI Trust Layer lets admins disable Autopilot, set policies, mask PII and audit every call. Trust page: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA support, FedRAMP for the public-sector cloud; ISO 42001 certified 27 Oct 2025 (Schellman). Enterprise adds bring-your-own models, encryption keys and credential vaults.
tools.licensing_pricing: Included with UiPath user and Studio licences rather than sold separately (available on Community, Basic and Enterprise; docs say not on the Free plan), subject to a monthly per-user quota (Enterprise Plus/App Tester 7x basic, Pro/App Test Developer 20x); generating, fixing and summarising expressions are unlimited. Under Unified Pricing each Autopilot for Everyone action consumes 0.2 Platform Units (1 AI Unit on Flex); admins top up with Platform Units. Plans: Community free; Basic from USD 25 per month (Europe region, limited scale); Standard, Enterprise and Test Cloud are contact sales. Not bundled with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
tools.integrations: Microsoft Teams, Slack and Microsoft 365 Copilot (conversational agents); Claude Code, Cursor and Codex (coding agents); MCP plug-ins; Test Cloud ALM connectors; models from Azure, AWS and Google via the LLM Gateway.
tools.recent_developments: 2025: Platform for Agentic Automation with Maestro and Agent Builder, named a TIME Best Invention. 30 Sept 2025 FUSION: UiPath Solutions, Maestro Case Management, conversational agents in Teams/Slack/Copilot, Unified Audit 2.0. Oct 2025: ISO 42001. Feb 2026: Agentic AI Foundation Gold Member, healthcare agentic solutions; FY2026 first GAAP-profitable year, ARR USD 1.853B. Aug 2026: Autopilot Coding Agent GA and model refresh (Claude Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, GPT-5.6). Sept 2026: Autopilot as coding agent inside Maestro (preview). FUSION 2026: Delegate desktop agent and Cartographer shipped without published pricing.
tools.best_fit_departments: 56 Business Operations & Process Excellence fits strongly: Autopilot in Maestro converts process descriptions into BPMN and flows, Process Apps give operational visibility and Cartographer maps processes; SOP creation is indirect (documentation derived from workflows). No weak departments listed.
tools.training_notes: Learners must distinguish Autopilot (assistive) from agents (autonomous), review generated workflows before publishing, test and validate, apply AI Trust Layer policies, track quota and Platform Unit consumption, set data-residency options and keep humans in the loop in Maestro. Advanced (56): 12-20 h covering Studio Web and Maestro authoring with Autopilot, BPMN basics, Orchestrator monitoring and Trust Layer administration.
tools.caveats: Per-user quotas and Platform Unit metering can surprise budgets; many 2026 features are preview; new products ship without pricing; model deprecations auto-migrate so behaviour can drift; on-premises needs Automation Suite 26.3+; enterprise pricing is quote-only.
